purpose: Locate one engineering ISL-pressure bracket without treating zero-rate, disconnection, access failure, NO_ROUTE growth or incomplete drain as congestion.
analysis_block_behavior: If receipt verification or V2 analysis fails before a VERIFIED manifest exists, stop the cohort and record invalid evidence. Never reinterpret a blocked analysis as NO_PRESSURE_PHYS_VALID or run the next bandwidth.

ordered_classification.when: Either arm fails a per-arm physical-validity condition, or the candidate exceeds the control on a declared differential condition, including access, geometry, outage, NO_ROUTE, holding-queue overflow or control-plane failure evidence. ISL_QUEUE_OVERFLOW is not a physical-invalid fate.
ordered_classification.action: Stop the bandwidth bracket. Do not call the result congestion. Move only to a separately preregistered traffic or OD-hotspot axis under physically plausible links.

ordered_classification.when: Physical validity passes but either arm fails a drain-validity condition.
ordered_classification.action: Do not run 1 MHz and do not compare algorithms. Repeat the same candidate with unchanged emission and a separately reviewed longer observation/drain horizon.

ordered_classification.when: Physical and drain validity pass, but the 5 MHz control already contains a localized pressure-candidate episode, whether or not the 2 MHz arm also contains one. ISL_QUEUE_OVERFLOW may be reported as a supplementary congestion outcome but cannot replace the localized episode.
ordered_classification.action: Stop. Do not claim a 5-to-2 MHz onset interval. Report whether the 2 MHz signal is concordant or non-monotone, and locate a physically valid no-pressure upper arm before any onset claim. Reanalyse or rerun the prior 50 MHz upper arm under this same window contract rather than launching 1 MHz.

ordered_classification.when: Physical and drain validity pass, the 5 MHz control has no pressure-candidate episode, and the 2 MHz candidate has one directed ISL with at least two consecutive eligible 1 s windows at utilization >= 0.8 plus queue waiting that overlaps that same episode with max wait >= 0.1 s and episode queue area >= 100000 bit-s. ISL_QUEUE_OVERFLOW is supplementary and does not invalidate an otherwise qualified episode.
ordered_classification.action: Stop the bandwidth bracket. Freeze the engineering onset statement to the interval between 5 MHz and 2 MHz; do not infer a dose-response curve or a 1 MHz result. Confirm the adjacent bracket with preregistered seeds before any paper claim.

ordered_classification.when: Physical and drain validity pass and neither arm contains a pressure-candidate episode.
ordered_classification.action: Create R04 as 2 MHz versus 1 MHz with the same trace, seed, routing, topology, access, demand, horizon and this unchanged decision contract.

claim_boundary: This single-seed bracket is an engineering calibration, not a statistical effect estimate.
Bandwidth changes noise, SNR, MCS and control service time as physical consequences; it is not a pure capacity multiplier.
Utilization without same-link queue waiting is insufficient for a pressure classification.
High utilization and queue waiting on the same link but at disjoint times are insufficient for a pressure classification.
A 5-to-2 MHz onset interval requires the 5 MHz arm to pass the same no-pressure test; candidate-only classification cannot establish a bracket.

ISL_QUEUE_OVERFLOW is a congestion outcome, not a disconnection or access failure. If the earlier physical, drain or localized 5 MHz control-pressure branches have not already determined a stop, an arm with ISL_QUEUE_OVERFLOW but no localized qualified pressure episode blocks classification rather than proving pressure or no-pressure.
A result selected by this tree cannot support algorithm superiority, information value, Q0 optimality or a new-algorithm claim.
